entities.name: Mardia
entities.description: Vampire cleric stationed at Fort Adanto, part of the Legion of Dusk on Ixalan.

entities.name: Mavren Fein
entities.description: Hierophant, a crazed starving vampire Mardia let into Fort Adanto.

entities.name: Manuel
entities.description: Criminal arranged to break Mavren Fein's Blood Fast; Mavren drank his blood.

entities.name: Fort Adanto
entities.description: Adanto, the First Fort, a Legion of Dusk fort on Ixalan.

events.summary: Mardia responds to the cries of a crazed starving vampire outside Fort Adanto and recognizes Hierophant Mavren Fein.
events.quote: Recognizing him as Hierophant Mavren Fein

events.summary: Mardia pins the frenzied Mavren Fein to the ground when he attacks the guards.
events.quote: Mardia intervened, pinning him to the ground and preventing further violence.

events.summary: Mavren tears down the wall between cells and drinks Manuel's blood.
events.quote: Mavren tore down the wall between the cells and drank Manuel's blood.

relations.note: She is a cleric of the Legion of Dusk.
relations.quote: part of the Legion of Dusk on Ixalan

relations.note: She is a priest stationed there.
relations.quote: Mardia is a dedicated priest at Fort Adanto
